executive_summary: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office has updated its travel guidance for the Levant amid ongoing regional conflicts. All travel is advised against to Gaza, parts of the West Bank, and northern Israel near the borders with Lebanon and Syria. Only essential travel is recommended for remaining areas of the West Bank due to security risks and tensions.

regional_sections.summary: Verified Official — FCDO advises against all travel to Gaza and parts of the West Bank and northern Israel near borders with Lebanon and Syria due to conflict and regional tensions; against all but essential travel to other parts of the West Bank.
